name: electricalplan-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `electricalPlan` flag (pro tier — off in Simple like its host `report`/'Drawing set' File-menu entry). openDrawingSet() opens a new window and calls document.write with the multi-sheet HTML; window.open is intercepted (returns a stub capturing the written HTML) so the real popup never spawns. Asserts the flag is OFF in Simple mode, an 'Electrical plan' sheet is present by default once in Pro, and absent after a direct setFeatureFlag override turns it off while STAYING in Pro (report/Drawing set entry unaffected) — proving electricalPlan itself, not just the pro-tier switch, gates the sheet's CONTENT (restoring it brings the sheet back).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: electricalPlan should be OFF in Simple mode (it is pro-tier)

steps.name: assert-drawing-set-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Drawing set')) throw new Error('Drawing set row visible in Simple mode File menu (should be Pro-only, gated by the report flag)'); })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: assert-drawing-set-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.pop-panel')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Drawing set')) throw new Error('Drawing set row missing in Pro mode File menu'); })()

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open (dynamic import/build likely failed)

steps.name: assert-electrical-sheet-present
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!window.__capturedHtml.includes('Electrical plan')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML has no Electrical plan sheet while electricalPlan flag is ON'); })()

steps.name: click-drawing-set-flag-off
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured-flag-off
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML on the flag-off run

steps.name: assert-electrical-sheet-absent
steps.eval: (function(){ if (window.__capturedHtml.includes('Electrical plan')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML still has an Electrical plan sheet after setFeatureFlag(electricalPlan, false)'); })()

steps.name: click-drawing-set-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured-restored
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML on the restored run

steps.name: assert-electrical-sheet-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!window.__capturedHtml.includes('Electrical plan')) throw new Error('Electrical plan sheet did not reappear after restoring electricalPlan to true'); window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; })()
